# Sådan finder du 'value for money

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-07  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Millionærklubben episode kicks off the stock game. Guest Kurt Karr of Maj Invest spends most of it on macro: very high government debt will likely lead to 'financial repression', with inflation tolerated and rates held down. He argues investors should think in real rather than nominal terms and favour real assets and pricing power: gold and silver mines, semiconductor fabs and data centres. He says to avoid software, telecom operators and airlines such as SAS. The US jobs report and the upcoming ECB rate decision are discussed but seen as giving little clarity.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ SAS — SAS | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Guest has long opposed airlines, especially SAS: no pricing power, undifferentiated product, shares fell 99.98%.

#### Reasoning

Kurt Karr (guest, Maj Invest) says airlines have no pricing power: customers just want to fly cheaply and every airline uses the same Airbus planes. In the inflationary financial-repression scenario he expects, companies that cannot raise prices should not be owned. SAS is his main example of lost value.

#### Sell Triggers

- if airlines gain real pricing power or differentiation

> *"Og så har jeg jo været en arv modstander af luftfartselskaber, især SAS."*

---

### 🟡 005930 — Samsung Electronics | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fund trimmed after a very strong run but still sees fabs as long-term real assets with high barriers to entry.

#### Reasoning

The guest's value fund benefited from semiconductors during the AI wave. After roughly a 700% rise in 6-7 months it took some profits, but he still sees chip fabs as a kind of gold mine: 5-10 years to build, scarce staff and a technology lead. That supports keeping a reduced position rather than exiting.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI and data-centre investment turns out to be overinvestment
- if the valuation keeps running up too fast

> *"Og det er måske kørt lidt for hurtigt, så vi har taget noget af det af også."*

---

### 🟠 ACC — Aker Carbon Capture | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Carbon capture stock the host raised; Lars Persson calls it a small speculative gamble because the technology is unproven.

#### Reasoning

The host brought up the Norwegian carbon capture stock after the guest talked about carbon-capture breakthroughs. Lars Persson (participant) says the technology isn't there yet, being first doesn't mean being best, and it should only be a small gambling slice of a portfolio. The guest says his point was not a recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the technology fails to become commercially viable
- if a competing technology wins

> *"Men tør man, og har man en lille portion til gambling"*
